sourceDescription: AnixQ — аниме с AnimeLib: каталог, плеер без рекламы, синхронизация с Shikimori.

appRepositories.appDescription:
Share extension, character pages, quick actions, smart continue, dub alerts

- 'Что за аниме?' share extension: share any image from TikTok, Photos or
  Telegram; characters are recognised (AnimeTrace), the title found on
  Shikimori and opened in AnixQ or added to Запланировано
- Character and person pages (Shikimori): description, seiyu / voiced
  characters, their anime linking back into AnimeLib; staff and characters
  on the title page are tappable
- Long-press quick actions on every poster (Смотрю / В планы / Любимые /
  Просмотрено, share); 'Хочу посмотреть' in frame search results
- Smart continue: finished episodes offer the next one; 'Продолжение
  франшиз' shelf with the next main entry of finished titles
- Notification when the newest episode appears with the user's own dub team;
  background refresh via BGTaskScheduler
- Fix: frame search screen failed to compile (missing brace)
